name: Saudi Oil Burn Forecaster
info: Time series forecasting model to predict oil consumption/burn in Saudi Arabia. Uses SARIMA (Seasonal AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average) to forecast monthly oil consumption in thousand barrels per day, incorporating seasonal patterns and trends in Saudi Arabia's oil demand.

forecast_steps.name: forecast_steps
forecast_steps.tooltip: Number of future time periods (months) to forecast. Typical range is 1-24 months for reliable predictions.

start_date.name: start_date
start_date.tooltip: Start date for the forecast period. Should be a future date from when you want predictions to begin.

confidence_level.name: confidence_level
confidence_level.tooltip: Confidence level for prediction intervals. Higher values give wider confidence bands around forecasts.

include_historical.name: include_historical
include_historical.tooltip: Include recent historical fitted values in the response for context and trend visualization.

output.description: Returns oil consumption forecasts with confidence intervals

format.model_type: Type of forecasting model used (SARIMA or Seasonal Naive)
format.historical_data: Optional: Recent historical values for context
